html:
The Kivu conflict is the war in the eastern Congo provinces of North and South Kivu that continued after the end of the Second Congo War, from 2004 to the present.

Rebel groups backed by Rwanda, such as the CNDP and later the M23, fought the Congolese army and Hutu militias descended from those who fled after the genocide. Over a hundred armed groups fight for land, power and minerals, and sexual violence is widespread. M23 briefly took Goma in 2012.

The M23 rose again from 2021, and in early 2025 it took Goma and Bukavu, with Rwandan troops alongside it, according to United Nations experts. Millions have been displaced. Doctors such as Denis Mukwege have treated the victims. It continues the wars that began with the refugee crisis in the Congo.
sum: The Kivu conflict is the war in the eastern Congo provinces of North and South Kivu that continued after the end of the Second Congo War, from 2004 to the present.
